resolutions: The amended plan frontmatter attests the complete active corpus through accepted Decisions 0069 and 0070. The protected plan is explicitly transitional and will be replaced by the plan recorder immediately after this requirements pass.

The exact selected option description says other independent work may continue while coordinator handoff waits until every required exchange closes. The amended plan and Decision 0064 apply that meaning: causal work pauses, independent dependency-ready work may continue, and coordinator transfer waits.

D-0032 is resolved and the amended plan, bound graph, replacement decomposition and replacement task plan all assign the complete combined-review protocol to NATIVE-FOREGROUND-ACTIVATE. The normal recorders replace the stale protected handover before delegation.

The replacement First criteria and matching plan_contract statements introduce exactly one shared review-set schema and forbid only a second review registry or CI evidence parser. Their byte-identical criteria remove the stale contradiction.

The amended plan and Shared contract require preserving any exact nonblank submitted answer, including free-form text outside the offered labels, while a chosen label is preserved exactly. Focused recorder tests must prove both cases and malformed blank answers refuse.

PostToolUse completion coverage applies only to tools that return completed answers in the call. Required structured exchanges use synchronous request_user_input. Async issuance is PreToolUse-guarded optional clarification, has no gate or approval authority, and is neither a completed exchange nor completion evidence.

Required structured exchanges are synchronous and cannot outlive their call. A coordinator cannot change while that call executes; after return or cancellation the old coordinator stops, and cancellation grants no authority. Async clarification creates no required exchange or pending authority, so no durable pending-question ledger is needed.
The amended AC5 crosswalk now includes NATIVE-LIFECYCLE, and the bound graph adds AC5 to that task while preserving First, Shared, Portable and Integration consumers.

D-0033 makes Toolshed a zero-mutation deferral until exact identity and mutation authority are supplied. The amended plan, graph and decomposition require the three configured client proofs and retain Toolshed as an explicit nonblocking limitation.

The amended setup contract selects the first applicable tier: one valid explicit argument, else one valid environment value, else exactly one detected host, else TTY. A higher tier suppresses lower-tier disagreement; multiple explicit values, invalid selected input, cancellation, EOF or missing interactive answer refuse before repair, while both or neither detected host reaches TTY.

The amended plan parses each actual provider pass from overall_explanation, or recursively from pass_reports[*].report for exact chunk 1/N order. It treats 3,000 characters as the per-report overall_explanation maximum, validates required marker/verdict boilerplate before launch, rejects oversized output, and never treats the synthesized top-level chunk summary as an assessment.

Portable enumerates every regular unlinked task-scoped quality/performance/security triple and only story triples that exact shipped history identifies with one marker. It sorts path/story/task/hash into a whole-inventory sentinel; incomplete, multiply bound, done-but-unsealed, ambiguous or unbound archives remain display-only and any unsafe authoritative candidate refuses before mutation.
